Chapter 7138: Out Of Time

Chapter 7138: Out Of Time

No one wanted to answer the question. Thus, curiosity accumulated even more.

The death of Skykiller shocked everyone - a true tragedy. However, no one knew the details behind it. With time, they forgot about this matter.

“We’re out of time.” Lunar Wolf changed the subject.

“Elder, it is not too late to change your mind.” Gluttonous said.

Worldbearer glanced at the maelstrom and said: “I say the same to you all. We are responsible for protecting this world.”

“Only to protect our kind.” All could hear a clear voice, whether they be in the past, present, or the future.

“Pop!” A qilin appeared in the air, releasing unbearable heatwaves. This was just the natural heat from its eternal flames.

“His Excellency Qilin is here now.” Stone Immortal murmured.

“Qilin, you have made up your mind?” Worldbearer’s expression changed.

“Elder, nothing is more important than the survival of our kind.” Qilin responded.

“So you are willing to refine Divine Firmament just to survive the calamity, all the living beings to be used as nourishment.” Worldbearer took a deep breath.

“Elder, they will die because of the calamity. If their fate is inevitable, why not use them as nourishment?” Qilin said.

Listeners were shocked to hear this. Speculation was one thing but Qilin had just confirmed it.

They naturally understood what was going on upon seeing the devouring maelstrom. Nonetheless, they still hoped for a more optimistic possibility. Alas, Qilin revealed the cruel truth.

“Using us as nourishment?!” Many powerful cultivators screamed in indignation. Unfortunately, this didn’t change their powerlessness.

“Nothing can be done.” Stone Immortal lamented.

This helplessness had been established epochs ago. After all, who would want to be eternal servants? Alas, they couldn’t resist the nine great divine beasts. It was either obey or be massacred.

“Why?!” Weaker cultivators didn’t think as much and only lamented their current fate.

They viewed the divine beasts as protectors once. Some happily joined the dragon servants, taking pride in serving the great ones.
